correctness.rationale: For any d>=6, 2d centers +/-e_i/d cover the l1 unit ball at scale (d-1)/d by choosing a maximal-modulus coordinate t>=||x||_1/d and checking two cases t>=1/d and t<=1/d; this establishes the upper bound for <=2d+3 translates. For any lambda<r, 2d vertices must occupy distinct translates (mutual l1 distance 2), and no translate containing a vertex can contain a sign-facet barycenter (distance >=2r>2lambda). At most three additional translates must cover all 2^d sign barycenters. Incompatibility at Hamming distance >=d-1 makes each covering class an independent set in H_2(d,d-1). Harney–Gluesing-Luerssen Thm3.3 explicitly proves this graph has chromatic number 4 for d>=3, contradiction. An independent exact check recomputed Hamming adjacencies, odd-generator parity relation and 4-color construction for dimensions 3..8; unbounded lower bound rests on the published chromatic theorem, not finite tests.
residual_risks: Computational corroboration is restricted to the stated finite class; it is not a general numerical experiment proof.
